items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And Celestan, the great Celestan, that was coming to him every year in June when school closed, they'd hire Celestan's band to play for us. That's when I first saw Henry Zeno. And Celestan, and Johnny Dodson, fellas like that.

ctx.x: And so- Any other relatives play any music?

I don't remember any relatives of mine that ever played any music. And as I know of, I had an uncle supposed to graduate this conservatory in Boston, a great uncle but I never did see him, my mother told him about it but I never did see it. And Celestan, the great Celestan, that was coming to him every year in June when school closed, they'd hire Celestan's band to play for us. That's when I first saw Henry Zeno.
